description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). The connected creator's Piku Wallet: the balance by currency (available, and pending for withdrawals not landed yet), the total withdrawn, the latest withdrawals with their status (Asked, Approved, On hold, Sent, Received, Paid or Failed) and the minimum one withdrawal can be. Read only: it cannot withdraw or move money. When the wallet is not open on the account, says so.
name: get_wallet
title: Read your wallet
